description: Controlled vocabulary for asset labels. Every manifest item is validated against this file. Add a value here first, then use it.

style-ref.note: Reference images given to an image model to borrow a drawing style. Category = style slug.

character.note: Story design sheets (cast, expressions, turnarounds, and prop-structure sheets made in the same set) and cut-out sprites. Category = sheet template from fairytale-art-prompts. Always tagged story:<slug>. cutout-sheet = magenta character cut-out sheet (art-prompts template 7).

background.note: Full-frame or panning scenery. Category = location type.

prop.note: Objects placed in a scene (ship, tent, tree, star, puff of smoke).

music.note: Background music longer than about 10 seconds.

jingle.note: Short musical stingers under about 10 seconds.

sfx.note: One-shot sound effects. cartoon = boing/pop/slide whistle; foley = footsteps, doors, cloth; body = yawn, snore, heartbeat.

instrument.note: Playable instruments: multisample folders, soundfonts, or code synth voices.

voice.note: Frozen TTS character voices: one folder per voice id (assets/audio/voices/<voice-id>/) with ref.wav (the reference clip), voice.json (tool record) and manifest.json. Category = role (narrator, child, adult, elder, creature for animals and monsters). Written by tts/bin/tts pick/approve; approval needs provenance fields and a commercial source.

facets.story: free: kebab-case story slug, e.g. story:troy
facets.instrument: free: kebab-case instrument name, e.g. instrument:glockenspiel
facets.character: free: kebab-case character slug, e.g. character:odysseus

statuses.approved: Checked by a person; safe to use in new work.
statuses.candidate: Registered but not reviewed yet; listen/look before using.
statuses.reference-only: May be shown to a model or a person as reference; never ship it inside an output.
statuses.rejected: Kept for the record; do not use.

scopes.story: Belongs to one story (tag story:<slug>); reuse only for sequels or that story.
